chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Qabisah, from Abdullah al-Naysaburi, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Abu Musa, from Abu al-A'la al-Shami, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Abu Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Feed your pregnant women the dairy (products), for the child, when it feeds in the belly of its mother with the dairy (products), its heart gets stronger and there is an increase in its intellect. So if it happens to be a boy, he would be brave and if a female is born her buttocks would be larger, so she would enjoy by that with her husband'.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of feeding pregnant women dairy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Hasan (AS) via the Prophet (PBUH) highlights the spiritual and physical benefits of maternal nutrition, specifically dairy, during pregnancy. It connects prenatal care to the child's character traits, such as courage in males and marital favor in females, reflecting the Shia emphasis on holistic well-being rooted in prophetic tradition.
